text.tspan: KALT / SS Commercial Refrigeration. https://ss-refrigeration.vercel.app — live and public.

This canvas draws only what is deployed. The Phase 1 roadmap — R2, QStash, WhatsApp, the admin — is ss-refrigeration-free-tier, which by design contains components that do not exist yet; this one does not. The Phase 2-3 target canvas (Kafka, OpenSearch, multi-AZ) was deleted on 2026-10-12:
its triggers have not fired and the picture was being read as the plan. HLD.md keeps the reasoning.
Open faults and their fixes: docs/ops/REMEDIATION-PLAN.md

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: THE SITE RENDERS CORRECTLY AND CAPTURES NOTHING. Lead capture is the only revenue path, and it is closed.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: POST /api/leads returns 400 captcha_failed on every request. lib/adapters/captcha.ts fails closed in production, which is correct on its own — but no Turnstile widget exists in any component, so no request can carry a token. Setting TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY does not fix it; that only changes the error to "Missing verification token".
Everything that builds, renders and deploys is green. 22 routes, 18 passing browser checks, no console error, no failed request. Every one of those checks tested rendering. None submitted the form.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Read path is healthy and entirely static. Write path stops at the second hop.

text.tspan: 22 routes. Every page sets revalidate = false, so nothing regenerates on a timer and the database sleeps between deploys. This is HLD-FREE-TIER §4.1 enforced, and it is the decision that keeps the Neon compute budget intact.

text.tspan: src/modules/* are the seams; each exposes only index.ts and an ESLint rule enforces it. src/lib/container.ts is the composition root — it reads the capability flags in env.ts and wires a real adapter or deregisters the channel. That is why a missing token degrades one feature instead of breaking the lead path.

text.tspan: R2 bucket and the AVIF derive pipeline · lib/image-loader.ts · QStash queue and the 15-minute sweeper schedule · Upstash Redis · WhatsApp Cloud API and the WhatsApp-first call to action · Resend · Telegram · Turnstile widget · synthetic lead probe · nightly pg_dump · /admin and Auth.js · careers, news, installations · search UI · Debezium, Kafka,
They are not errors in those documents — they are the plan. They are omitted here so that this canvas can be trusted as a description of the running system. Status table: HLD-FREE-TIER.md §0a.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Legend: green = built, configured and verified · amber = built but degraded, or a limit worth watching · red = broken, missing, or non-compliant · grey = present in code but unconfigured, so inert · teal = built and serving (render tier, modules) · blue = the visitor · yellow-edge = host and CDN. Every claim on this canvas was checked
against the live deployment on 2026-10-12 — see the docstring in _src/gen_current.py for the exact commands. Faults and fixes: docs/ops/REMEDIATION-PLAN.md
